name: worldview-kanonak-tooling
description: The kanonak CLI the publish, guards and wiki workflows run, installed with npm ci from the lockfile, so a new release can't change CI without a commit here. Since 8.16.0 its publish refuses to drop or change a version the origin serves, since 8.12.0 its validate reads each import at the newest version its range admits, and since 8.21.0 its wiki draws every band these packages' looks use.
